text.title: Internal Link Audit Procedure
text.summary: Eight steps from crawl to a validated audit report: run and reconcile a rendered crawl, split incoming counts by link position and flag hubs, decide every orphan, build the pillar-cluster matrix, tabulate anchor text, list hygiene findings, write the fully specified rewire plan, capture the Search Console baseline and the re-measurement date, then validate.

step.name: run-and-reconcile-the-crawl
step.input: Crawler with JavaScript rendering (Screaming Frog, Sitebulb or in-house); the XML sitemap; the CMS published-page count; the audit period.
step.action: Crawl the full host inside the period; keep only HTTP 200, non-noindex, self-canonical pages as `crawl.indexable_pages`. Record `crawler`, `crawl_date`, `javascript_rendered: true`, `sitemap_urls`, `cms_published_pages`; for every gap above 5 percent add a `discrepancies[]` entry with `gap_pct` and an `explanation` (robots_blocked, paginated, js_rendered, sitemap_stale, noindexed_in_cms).
step.decision-gate: Fewer than 30 indexable pages or no declared cluster: skip per 06-decision-tree.xml; a gap above 5 percent without an explanation: rescope and recrawl before any analysis (r-crawl-scope-reconciled).

step.name: split-incoming-counts-by-link-position
step.input: The crawler's inlinks export with link position (content vs navigation, footer, sidebar, breadcrumb).
step.action: For every indexable page count unique linking pages whose link sits in the main content as `contextual_incoming` and the rest as `boilerplate_incoming`; record `incoming_counts.basis: contextual`, at least the top 20 and every candidate rewire target in `pages[]`, and pages above the hub `threshold` in `over_linked_hubs[]`.
step.decision-gate: Only a total inlinks count is available: export link position first; orphans and hubs are never computed on the total (r-incoming-count-excludes-boilerplate).

step.name: decide-every-orphan
step.input: Indexable pages with zero contextual incoming links, plus URLs known only from the sitemap or analytics.
step.action: List each in `orphans[]` with `found_via` and exactly one `decision`: rewire (with `source_url` and `anchor_text`, mirrored as a `rewire_plan` item), redirect (with `redirect_target`), or deindex.
step.decision-gate: An orphan with no decision or "leave as is" is not accepted (r-orphan-gets-a-decision).

step.name: build-the-pillar-cluster-matrix
step.input: The declared topic clusters (pillar URL plus 5 or more cluster URLs); the contextual link graph.
step.action: For each cluster record `cluster_pages[]` with `links_to_pillar` and `pillar_links_to_it`, `cluster_to_pillar_links` as the count of true, and `structurally_incomplete: true` when that count is below 5. Turn every false edge into a `rewire_plan` add item.
step.decision-gate: A cluster that exists in the content calendar but not in the graph is reported as incomplete, never silently passed (r-pillar-cluster-reciprocity).

step.name: tabulate-anchor-text
step.input: Anchor text per inlink for every rewire target and every top-20 page; image links with their alt text.
step.action: Record `anchor_text[]` per target with `total_links` and `anchors[]` (`anchor`, `count`, `share` = count / total_links, `generic` true for click here, read more, this article, raw URLs, empty alt). Draft rewire anchors that describe the target and vary in wording across new links.
step.decision-gate: A generic anchor not flagged, or one identical anchor on every new link to a target: fix before the plan is issued (r-anchor-text-descriptive).

step.name: list-hygiene-findings
step.input: The crawler's response codes, canonical and nofollow reports.
step.action: Record every internal link into a 3xx, 4xx, 5xx, noindex, foreign-canonical or nofollow target in `hygiene_findings[]` with `source_url`, `current_target`, `final_url`, `issue`. Use only final self-canonical URLs as rewire targets.
step.decision-gate: A rewire item pointing at a `current_target` from this list is a defect (r-link-targets-final-url).

step.name: write-the-rewire-plan
step.input: Orphan decisions, false matrix edges, generic anchors to replace, hygiene findings to fix; the editor who will execute.
step.action: Write `rewire_plan[]` in `templates/internal-link-audit.report.md.j2`: each item with `source_url`, `target_url`, exact `anchor_text`, `placement` (the paragraph or section), `action` (add, change_anchor, remove, redirect), a named `owner` and `due_date`. Never target a page in `over_linked_hubs`.
step.decision-gate: "Add more links to X" or "strengthen the cluster" is rejected; every item must be pasteable into a CMS task (r-rewire-item-fully-specified).

step.name: capture-the-search-console-baseline-and-validate
step.input: Google Search Console Performance report for the 28 days before the period end; the last rewire `due_date`.
step.action: For every rewire target record `gsc_baseline[]` (`clicks`, `impressions`, `average_position`, `contextual_incoming`, `window_days: 28`). Set `remeasurement.date` at least 56 days after the last due date with `metrics` clicks, impressions, average_position. Run `scripts/validate-internal-link-audit.py --file` on the report.
step.decision-gate: No rewire item ships before its target's baseline is captured; a re-measurement earlier than 8 weeks is not accepted (r-pre-post-search-console-baseline).

list.item: Report validates via `scripts/validate-internal-link-audit.py` with no violation, including reconciliation, matrix-to-plan mapping, hub and redirect exclusions and baseline coverage.
Every orphan has a decision, every false cluster edge and every rewire orphan has a plan item, and every plan item names a person and a date.
The re-measurement is in the calendar with the same three Search Console metrics as the baseline.
